scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
